about: Maps each seeded signal in the dataset to the rubric v0.9 dimension + facet + verbatim observable act it exercises, and its polarity in each quarter. This is the precise alignment between the simulated data and team-assess/rubric/five-dysfunctions.yaml (v0.9), which expands Lencioni's five dimensions into observable OBM behavioral facets.
polarity_note: 'absent' means the healthy act is conspicuously missing (itself a dysfunction reading); 'dysfunction' means a dysfunction act is present; 'healthy' means the healthy act is present.
